_comment: Who the release sheriff is, and who reviews what the sheriff writes.
The sheriff is a FIXED role, declared here. It used to be derived from the
Datadog layer 'Release Sheriff' on the frontend on-call schedule, which is a
different job: on-call pages for incidents and hands over weekly, the sheriff
shepherds releases through QA. One rotation cannot be both, and reading the
release owner off the paging rota is what coupled them.
backupReviewer MUST be someone other than the sheriff. GitHub rejects a
self-review request, so backport PRs the sheriff authors would be assigned to
their own author with nobody asked to review — and backport-auto-merge.yaml
only merges on an approval, so they would wait on a review that was never
